import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = scanner.next();
        StringBuilder x = new StringBuilder();
        boolean ok = true;
        int i = 0;
        while (i < s.length()) {
            if (i + 3 <= s.length() && s.substring(i, i + 3).equals("dot")) {
                x.append('.');
                i += 3;
            } else if (i + 2 <= s.length() && s.substring(i, i + 2).equals("at") && ok && i != 0) {
                x.append('@');
                i += 2;
                ok = false;
            } else {
                x.append(s.charAt(i));
                i++;
            }
        }
        String result = x.toString();
        for (int j = 0; j < result.length(); j++) {
            char c = result.charAt(j);
            if (j == 0 && c == '.') {
                System.out.print("dot");
            } else if (j == 0 && c == '@') {
                System.out.print("at");
            } else if (j == result.length() - 1 && c == '@') {
                System.out.print("at");
            } else if (j == result.length() - 1 && c == '.') {
                System.out.print("dot");
            } else {
                System.out.print(c);
            }
        }
        System.out.println();
        scanner.close();
    }
}
